canonical_project: Hanseatic and University City of Rostock Municipal Data Center (Toitenwinkel)
owner: Hanseatic and University City of Rostock; PBIT Systeme / DC-Datacenter-Group
notes: First municipal data center, spatenstich 2025-10-29 in Toitenwinkel; shell planned complete Q1 2026, overall completion September 2026; about EUR 6m, 300 kW IT load, 90 sqm white space in two data halls; serves the city and partners such as the Südstadt-Klinikum.
